contexts.text: I felt the severity of the influx during my sleep.

Weight in the natural world corresponds to good in the Spiritual World; and extension, to truth. For in Heaven... there is neither weight, nor extension... there do indeed appear things heavy and extended with Spirits, but they are appearances originating from the states of good and truth in a higher Heaven.
He induced a great heaviness in the stomach. AC 5715:end. AC 5723.

The eyes of Israel were heavy () = his obscure apperception.
It is like an effort towards the centre of gravity.
I am heavy in mouth, and I am heavy in tongue () = that the voice and speech from the Divine are not heard or perceived. Explained.
An exceedingly grievous pestilence () AC 7577. AC 7685.
And led it in heaviness () = resistance and impotence.
They fell to lower things as from weight. Signified, Explained.
Falsity from evil is of such a nature that it falls down towards lower things, like a heavy body in the world.
Evil corresponds to what is heavy on earth, which sinks by its own weight.
That evils dragged them down to lower things, like weights, in the world. Signified, Explained.

It is evil which makes weight in the spiritual sense, and which thus sinks down as from its weights; but not falsity, by itself; but from the evil which is in it; for falsity from itself has no weight.
Complaint from the severity of the temptation. Signified.
The hands of Moses were heavy () = that the power of looking upwards to the Lord was deficient.
The word is too heavy for thee () = that it is not possible, because not from order. Explained.
A heavy cloud was on the mountain () = the Divine state relatively to those who are about to receive. Explained.
The voice of a trumpet heavy () = the celestial state which was around.
The grievous things of repentance. Signified.
As they continually... gravitate downwards...
Direction in the world is what is called... gravitation.

They inject heavinesses in the head.

The intelligence of man is in itself severe, etc.

That the lust of fornicating is grievous, in proportion as it looks to adultery.
That adulteries done by these are grievous according to the confirmations.
That the adulteries done by these are in the highest degree grievous.
That the lot of these... after death is grievous.
He answered in a deep tone...
Anyone who is burdened in conscience...
Falsities... induce... a nature of heaviness.

He spoke... with such gravity as if he had been Solomon.

By removals of imperfections, such as the things which cause gravity, rest, and cold...
There is gravity in each least particle of man, which presses towards the earth; and as there is such a sphere of gravity in each thing, it is upwards or downwards to man according to the gravity.

As the leasts of the ether gravitate into the leasts of our body, to the centre, it is downwards when the centre is downwards... SE 4063.

All parts of the body... turn themselves... to the centre of gravity... Yet this centre of gravity is merely nature's centre of gravity; there is another centre of gravity in the Spiritual World; and this, with man, is determined by the love in which he is; downwards, if his love is infernal; upwards, if his love is heavenly; and whichever way man's love is determined, in the same way his thoughts and intentions are determined...

The purer ether, which is universal, from which is all gravity.
